title: Leave at 4:40

sources.licence: Mixkit licence: free for commercial use, no attribution required
sources.marks: None (no lettering or logos). A person in a yellow and blue dress walks through between 2.0 and 8.0 s, so keep out of that range.

sources.licence: Mixkit licence: free for commercial use, no attribution required
sources.marks: No logos; the tablet screen is blank. A seated person (torso and hands, out of focus) fills the background before about 20 s. In the stretch only a sliver of their sleeve shows at the far left edge (x < 0.04), and the crop drops it. Sticky notes at the far left are also outside the crop.

sources.licence: Mixkit licence: free for commercial use, no attribution required
sources.marks: No readable livery in the departure stretch (dark side and rear of the cars). On arrival (about 3-6 s) the cab's destination LED is readable: blur it or grade it down if that part is used. The station clock on the wall has no lettering.

sources.licence: Coverr licence: free for commercial use, no attribution required
sources.marks: Before about 9.5 s the cars carry a distinctive blue and yellow metro livery (no lettering, but recognisable), so start at 9.5 or later and desaturate. In the stretch a pink and purple advert poster with text sits on the right-hand wall (around x 0.55-0.65, y 0.38-0.48 of the frame) and red LED signs sit on the back wall (around y 0.37): blur or grade both out.

sources.licence: Coverr licence: free for commercial use, no attribution required
sources.marks: People are tiny and faceless from this height. The red and white coaches on the left track are outside the crop, and no lettering on the train is readable at this distance. Lift nothing; grade the white roofs down.
